$comment: Copy to .causeway/policy.json and fill in. The reference to your organization's managed policy — Causeway does not supply the policy. skills/decision-spine/reference/managed-policy.md defines every field. Record either at least one policy, or none with the reason. tools/doctor.sh reads this file.

policies.title: REPLACE — the policy's title
policies.applies_because: REPLACE — one sentence: why this policy binds this system
policies.source: REPLACE — where the authoritative text lives
policies.copy: REPLACE — path to the committed copy, or null if it may not be committed
